title: A Conversation With a Device: Everything in Phase 08, Together
fallback: No hardware is needed. The device is a simulation that streams telemetry, answers requests, and can be unplugged, power cycled and made to misbehave, and the conversation is tested against it on a virtual clock. On Linux and macOS the last test puts a pseudo terminal between the session and the simulated device, so the real serial port code and its real terminal settings carry the real bytes. On Windows that test is not built, because a virtual COM port needs a driver. With a USB serial adapter and a microcontroller that speaks the three messages in rc/io/sim_device.hpp, the same Session talks to hardware by changing one line, the path the opener opens.

artifact.note: the whole conversation in one object, and the device simulation that every later phase tests it against
